# elemento_privatenetwork (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Elemento privatenetwork resource on the cloud selected by `target`. Set exactly one of `uuid` or `billing_uuid`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `billing_uuid` (String) Portal billing UUID. Set exactly one of `uuid` or `billing_uuid`.
- `uuid` (String) Service UUID. Set exactly one of `uuid` or `billing_uuid`.

### Read-Only

- `auto_assign_cidr` (Boolean) Let the platform pick the CIDR block.
- `billing_frequency` (String) Billing period.
- `cidr` (String) CIDR block of the network.
- `creation_date` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `creator_uuid` (String) UUID of the account that created the resource.
- `last_updated` (String) Timestamp of the last update.
- `name` (String) Name of the network.
- `region` (String) Region the resource is in.
- `state` (String) Current state reported by the service.
- `status` (String) Current status of the resource.
- `subnets` (Attributes List) Subnets of the network. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets))
- `vpc_id` (String) ID of the VPC the resource belongs to.

<a id="nestedatt--subnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnets`

Read-Only:

- `az` (String) Availability zone of the subnet.
- `cidr` (String) CIDR block of the subnet.
- `subnet_id` (String) ID of the subnet.
